summary: Take s + 1 orthonormal eigenvectors of CᴴC with eigenvalue 0; in coordinates adapted to them the integral is a radial integral in s + 1 complex variables.

steps.lean: have H := C.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self; let Q := H.eigenvectorUnitary
steps.claim: H = CᴴC is hermitian; let Q be its unitary matrix of eigenvectors.

steps.lean:
let ⟨D, hD, d⟩ := @Finset.exists_subset_card_eq _ {i | H.eigenvalues i = 0} s.succ (by grind
    [card_subtype_compl, card_subtype, H.rank_eq_card_non_zero_eigs, rank_conjTranspose_mul_self])
steps.claim: Choose D ⊂ ι, |D| = s + 1, of indices with eigenvalue 0: their number is |ι| − rank H = |ι| − rank C ≥ s + 1 + 3(ϱ+1) − 3(ϱ+1).

steps.lean:
use D, Q.1.submatrix id (↑), (conjTranspose_mul_self_mul_eq_zero ..).1 (ext fun a i ↦
    congr($(H.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis i) a).trans (by simp; grind)), ext (congr($(Q.2.1) · ·).trans
    (by simp)), fun j ↦ .trans' ?_ ((lintegral_mono_set fun u h ↦ ?_).trans_eq
    (((((@measurePreserving_normSq_sphereDensity _ _ (D.card_pos.1 ?_).coe_sort).prod (.id _)).comp
    (volume_preserving_piEquivPiSubtypeProd ..)).comp (complexPlace.measurePreserving_mulVec Q.1ᴴ
    (det_of_mem_unitary (star Q).2).1)).setLIntegral_comp_preimage (f := fun p ↦
    (.ofReal (p.1 / 36))⁻¹ ^ s) (s := Iic (L * (L * L ^ j) ^ 2) ×ˢ closedBall 0 (L * L ^ j)) ?_ ?_))
steps.claim: Take D and O = the columns of Q at D: CO = 0 (an eigenvector v of eigenvalue 0 has ‖Cv‖² = v*Hv = 0) and OᴴO = 1 (Q unitary). For the integral, enlarge the domain and change variables u ↦ Qᴴu (measure preserving, Q unitary), split ℂ^ι = ℂ^D × ℂ^{rest}, and on ℂ^D pass to w ↦ |w|², which carries Lebesgue measure to π^{s+1}r^s/s! dr: the integral is at most the integral over r ≤ L(L·L^j)² and the rest in the ball of radius L·L^j of (r/36)^{−s}, leaving three side goals.

steps.lean:
erw [setLIntegral_prod_symm]; simp [restrict_withDensity, Iic_inter_Ioi]
  grw [lintegral_withDensity_le_lintegral_mul, setLIntegral_le_iSup_mul,
    iSup₂_le (a := .ofReal (4 * 3 ^ 144))]
steps.claim: Fubini; bound the radial integral by its integrand's supremum times the measure: (r/36)^{−s}·π^{s+1}r^s/s! ≤ 4·3^{144}… on the range, times the volume of the ball.

steps.lean:
· simp (disch := positivity) [*]
    grw [pi_gt_three, pi_le_four, pi_le_four, h4, h4, h4]; ring; gcongr <;> bound
steps.claim: The volume of the ball of radius L·L^j in the remaining coordinates is bounded with π ≤ 4 and 4 ≤ L.

steps.lean:
simp; intros
  grw [← exp_one_lt_three, exp_one_pow, ← pow_div_factorial_le_exp _ _ s, pi_le_four]
  simp (disch := finiteness) [← toReal_le_toReal, field, pow_succ, div_pow, d, ← mul_pow]; bound
steps.claim: The radial factor: 36^s·π^{s+1}/s! ≤ 4·3^{144}… using x^s/s! ≤ e^x, e < 3 and π ≤ 4; the result is at most (L²)^{99(ϱ+1)(j+1)}.

steps.lean:
have k i : ‖(Q.1ᴴ *ᵥ u) i‖ ≤ L * L ^ j := (norm_sum_le ..).trans (by
    simp; grw [entry_norm_bound_of_unitary Q.2, h _, ← c]; simp)
steps.claim: k: |(Qᴴu)_i| ≤ L·L^j when all |u_i| ≤ L^j: the entries of a unitary matrix have modulus ≤ 1 and |ι| ≤ L.

steps.lean:
simp (disch := positivity) [k, ↓star_dot_self_eq_norm_sq, norm_sq_eq]
  grw [k, ← c, ← D.card_le_univ]; simp
steps.claim: Hence Qᴴu lies in the box: |w|² ≤ |D|·(L·L^j)² ≤ L(L·L^j)² for its D-part and the rest lies in the ball.
